question: What is the absolute percent difference between the total federal expenditures reported in February 1938 and January 1939, rounded to the nearest tenths place in millions of dollars?
raw_response:
The values are clearly read from the "Summary of Federal Receipts and Expenditures" table (in millions of dollars):
- Total federal expenditures, February 1938 = 528
- Total federal expenditures, January 1939 = 693

Absolute percent difference, using February 1938 (the earlier reported value) as the base:
|693 − 528| / 528 × 100 = 165/528 × 100 = 31.25% → 31.2%

<FINAL_ANSWER>31.2</FINAL_ANSWER>
